people.name: Lajos Ligeti
people.field: orientalist and philologist, who specialized in Mongolian and Turkic languages

relations.subject: Lajos Ligeti
relations.evidence: He studied classical languages, but concentrated on Turkish and Hungarian philology at Budapest University under both Gyula Németh and Zoltán Gombocz, obtaining his doctorate in 1925.
